newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi rolls over Nov Super Light crude formula.
newsitem.headline: Saudi rolls over Nov Super Light crude formula.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has kept the official price formula for November-lifting Super Light crude unchanged from the previous month at the Oman/Dubai differential plus $2.40 per barrel, a trader said on Thursday.
Earlier in the day, traders said Saudi Arabia had raised its November-lifting crude price formula for other Saudi grades by five to 15 cents per barrel.

For November, Arab Light has been set at the Oman/Dubai differential plus 60 cents, Arab Medium at a discount of 30 cents, Arab Heavy at a discount of $1.05 and Arab Extra Light at a premium of $1.55, traders said.
